_comment: Cargo definition rows for payment analysis. Vanilla: extracted from MotorTown v0.7.19 pak (mt-pak-extract). schedule-i: the Schedule I supply-chain mod's cargo_entries.json (mt-pak-extract worktree) (illicit cargo — NOT in the vanilla cargos table). payment_sqrt_ratio=1.0 and max_delivery_distance=0 (unlimited) are create_cargopack struct defaults. Regenerate when the mod config or game version changes.
